edges.sentence: On 2026-09-08, Al Jazeera reported “Earlier, the group had accused Saudi Arabia of carrying out an air strike on a prison in al-Hazm, in the northern al-Jawf governorate, killing at least seven people.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “At least seven people, including a child, were killed and seven others were wounded in the strike in the Yemeni city of Hazem, the Houthis said.”.

On 2026-09-08, Associated Press reported “At least seven people, including a child, were killed and seven others were wounded.”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “Earlier, the group had accused Saudi Arabia of carrying out an air strike on a prison in al-Hazm, in the northern al-Jawf governorate, killing at least seven people.”.

On 2026-09-08, Associated Press reported “At least seven people, including a child, were killed and seven others were wounded.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “At least seven people, including a child, were killed and seven others were wounded in the strike in the Yemeni city of Hazem, the Houthis said.”.
